Observed

  • A large swatch shows the pattern: black squiggles, bars, and blobs of similar size spread evenly over white.
  • The heading reads “Bacterio | Ettore Sottsass” in heavy black sans-serif on a gray panel.
  • The text below says that Bacterio is the iconic pattern of the Memphis movement.

Why it belongs

The pattern that the Memphis specimen imitates with tiled squiggles. It is a real product, still in production, so it is the most direct source for Memphis surface pattern in this catalogue.

The page itself is not in the Memphis style, and the pattern is an image, so the fingerprint does not apply to this capture.
